summary: Both full halves inspected. The small slanted mark before i.e. is preserved as an unassigned graphic. The triangular divider is typed. Of is legible under the cancellation. The h in The has repeated typed impressions. The A/B exchanges in equations2,3,4 and the following inclusion chain are heavy continuous pen corrections over the old typed letters,despite the draft note calling them typist overstrikes. Implied has d over e. The a of as overlies t,and the s overlies a tentative rounded old letter. Below the first three letters of liser are three cancelled unreadable positions. The right-edge break after loca is joined without inventing an unseen hyphen. The o in Loc has an upper curved mark and lower tick of unsettled provenance,now drawn. Set has a pen s over an unreadable old impression. Thus shows no securely separable old glyph. The final n of interruption has an old g lower loop and ear,and is treated as a typed overwrite. The inserted a is typed. Existing typed insertions between,relation,the long familiar,and to me now agree with the scan.
